svg.title: Base Economics: $535,000 to $240,750
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-retained-revenue-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Economics: $535,000 to $240,750; subtitle: Four expense deductions leave exactly 45.0% annual owner net profit.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Formula v2.0 Base anchors are $535,000 annual operator revenue, $294,250 total expense, and $240,750 owner net profit. Expense categories are an illustrative allocation, not additional scorecard inputs. First and last bars are absolute totals; intermediate bars are signed deductions.; caption: The scorecard's gross revenue is already the operator's net retained fee and commission basis. Do not apply a second retained share haircut or add employer premiums and claim funds. Evaluate ASC 606 principal-agent presentation by contract.; stages: label: Retained operator revenue; value: $535,000 annual starting total; numeric value: 535000.0; detail: Combine earned PEPM advisory fees, retained stop-loss and TPA commissions, PBM advisory fees, and earned E-Mod refund splits. Exclude all underlying employer fund flows.; label: Delivery labor; value: Subtract $168,000; $367,000 remains; numeric value: -168000.0; detail: Budget delivery payroll or contracted capacity, specialist analysis, and account execution. Include each delivery expense once; owner distributions come from the final profit rather than creating another expense deduction.; label: Secure systems and records; value: Subtract $36,000; $331,000 remains; numeric value: -36000.0; detail: Cover encrypted storage, access logging, secure transfer, CRM administration, claims normalization, and permitted benchmark access. Do not place identifiable claims in unapproved general-purpose collaboration systems.; label: Acquisition and renewals; value: Subtract $48,000; $283,000 remains; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Fund employer research, referral development, renewal outreach, travel, and proposal execution. Account for the incumbent broker's defense and delayed procurement rather than booking every proposal as won.; label: Insurance and administration; value: Subtract $42,250; $240,750 remains; numeric value: -42250.0; detail: Cover professional liability and cyber coverage, licensing, contract review, bookkeeping, and ordinary administration. This is an expense allocation, not an employer claims reserve or an additional retained-share deduction.; label: Owner net profit; value: $240,750 annual ending total; numeric value: 240750.0; detail: $535,000 minus $168,000, $36,000, $48,000, and $42,250 equals $240,750. Dividing the ending profit by $535,000 gives exactly 45.0%; this final total is not another increment.

rect.title: label: Retained operator revenue; value: $535,000 annual starting total; numeric value: 535000.0; detail: Combine earned PEPM advisory fees, retained stop-loss and TPA commissions, PBM advisory fees, and earned E-Mod refund splits. Exclude all underlying employer fund flows.

label: Delivery labor; value: Subtract $168,000; $367,000 remains; numeric value: -168000.0; detail: Budget delivery payroll or contracted capacity, specialist analysis, and account execution. Include each delivery expense once; owner distributions come from the final profit rather than creating another expense deduction.

label: Secure systems and records; value: Subtract $36,000; $331,000 remains; numeric value: -36000.0; detail: Cover encrypted storage, access logging, secure transfer, CRM administration, claims normalization, and permitted benchmark access. Do not place identifiable claims in unapproved general-purpose collaboration systems.

label: Acquisition and renewals; value: Subtract $48,000; $283,000 remains; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Fund employer research, referral development, renewal outreach, travel, and proposal execution. Account for the incumbent broker's defense and delayed procurement rather than booking every proposal as won.

label: Insurance and administration; value: Subtract $42,250; $240,750 remains; numeric value: -42250.0; detail: Cover professional liability and cyber coverage, licensing, contract review, bookkeeping, and ordinary administration. This is an expense allocation, not an employer claims reserve or an additional retained-share deduction.

label: Owner net profit; value: $240,750 annual ending total; numeric value: 240750.0; detail: $535,000 minus $168,000, $36,000, $48,000, and $42,250 equals $240,750. Dividing the ending profit by $535,000 gives exactly 45.0%; this final total is not another increment.
